title: Robust Line Fit: Huber IRLS with Outliers
hints: Residual rᵢ = yᵢ − (m xᵢ + c), Jacobian row (xᵢ, 1) up to sign. Weighted normal equations: (Σ wᵢ JᵢJᵢᵀ) θ = Σ wᵢ Jᵢ yᵢ, which is a 2×2 system.
Huber weight: w = 1 if |r| ≤ k, else k/|r|. Start from the plain LS fit (all w = 1), then alternate: compute residuals → weights → re-solve.
MAD: median of |rᵢ − median(r)|, times 1.4826. std::nth_element finds a median in O(n). For even n, average the two middle values.
Degenerate check: the determinant of the 2×2 weighted system (or 'all x equal') ⇒ return (0,0).
